case_title: Second SLA line may not have the required document template
exception_description: Wave RA-7488 contains 20 contractual SLA orders. AI recommends splitting the work across two pack lines because a temporary crew has arrived, but the second line has not confirmed the required documentation template. The AI still proposes immediate release.
layer1_visible: Wave RA-7488 contains 20 contractual SLA orders. AI recommends splitting the work across two pack lines because a temporary crew has arrived, but the second line has not confirmed the required documentation template. The AI still proposes immediate release.
detail_expand: If the template or printer mapping is wrong, the full SLA wave must be reopened and reprinted. Holding everything on the primary line is slower, yet still feasible if checked early. The case is intentionally high stakes: verifying line readiness is costly, but failure under an SLA contract is much worse.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends using both lines immediately because visible labor capacity is available and queue time is currently the largest bottleneck.

decision_options.action_label: Release SLA wave across both lines now
Pause to verify template, printer, and crew readiness
Keep the full wave on the primary line only

current_disruptions.description: Pick station or scanner may be offline; throughput partially constrained

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: Extra capacity helps only if the second line is truly configured for the contractual wave.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores line ID, template version, readiness evidence, and final action.
traceability_text.uncertainty_trigger2: Line-2 template not confirmed for SLA docs
traceability_text.recommended_check: Check line-2 template version, printer map, and crew login before release.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: Line 2 was not ready, so immediate release caused SLA reprint, re-open, and delay penalties.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The readiness check caught the issue and kept the rework loss contained, even though the pause added cost.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: Keeping all work on the primary line was safe, but slower and more expensive than a targeted readiness check first.
